secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL (https://<project>.supabase.co) from Supabase dashboard > Project Settings > API

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase anon/public key from Supabase dashboard > Project Settings > API

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service_role key (server-only, never exposed to the browser) from Supabase dashboard > Project Settings > API

secrets.name: AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY
secrets.description: API key for the AI gateway used by the chat feature (defaults to https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh/v1). Optional — only needed to use the in-app chat.

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_AI_GATEWAY_URL
secrets.description: Optional custom AI gateway base URL (defaults to https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh/v1).
